title: Test bench function.eval: request
description: One call of a pure core function by name, without a record and without side effects. input is the function's input as a decision table case writes it (conformance/runner.md, section Decision table). Test bench port only.

function.description: commission.accuracy: from v0.3 the accuracy of a lens executor from its scored forecasts and outcomes (COM-17). digest.sample: the monthly audit sample from the verdicts, the settings and the seed (DIG-5). reporter.number_check: the check that a model paragraph holds no numbers, with the names of the table and catalog and the snapshot times as the allowed tokens (REP-4). schedule.check: the check of a schedule change: validity and the local times that disappear or repeat at the clock changes within a year (TIM-5).

input.description: The function's input: the given of a decision table case, with the same field names.
input.x-botaru-closed-by: the input of the named function, as the decision table of conformance/runner.md writes it
